h: Making a Filey day of it
p: Filey is the gentler, quieter neighbour to Scarborough and Bridlington, and that's exactly its charm. A long sweep of sandy beach curves round Filey Bay, perfect for buckets, spades and a game of cricket when the tide's out, and this arcade is right where you come down onto it.

When the kids have had their fill of the machines, walk north along the sand towards Filey Brigg, the rocky finger of land poking out into the sea. It's great for rock pools, but keep an eye on the tide, because it comes in quicker than you'd think. Back up the hill, the Crescent Gardens are a nice spot for a sit down with an ice cream.
